export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug 'kr-lifesciences-private-limited', address FMC FORTUNA, BLOCK A11, 4TH FLOOR 234/3A, A.J.C BOSE ROAD) shows the company as shipper on outbound rows, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-19 | KR LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED | MODERN LIMITED | CYPERMETHRIN 93% TC CAS NO: 52315-07-8 | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 38089135 | 9816335" and "2026-02-23 | KR LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED | HARCROS CHEMICALS (PRIVATE) LIMITED | FOR AGRICULTURAL USE GLYPHOSATE 71% SG (W/W) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Colombo, Sri Lanka | 38089399 | 9912323". Page counter states "Total Shipments 672 Records detected", "Trading Partners 32", "Ports 20", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26"; rows actually rendered on the free view: 5 shipment rows (3 inbound China->India, 2 outbound India->UAE/Sri Lanka) plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows. Buyer-side counterparties listed for export lanes: MOSCO MARKETING LIMITED (Dhaka, Bangladesh, 38 shipments), AAMIDEX BIOSCIENCE LLC (Tashkent, Uzbekistan, 234), CLEAN AGRO (180), POSITIVE INTERNATIONAL LIMITED (Mwanza, Tanzania, 14).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, domestic supply contract or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved. Searches for "KR Lifesciences" + GeM/tender/GST returned only unrelated Kroger (NYSE: KR) results; thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. Nothing found is not proof of absence — domestic sales are simply not publicly documented in the sources reachable here.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: two dated outbound customs records with destination country, HS code and B/L number (B/L 9816335 to Jebel Ali UAE 2026-02-19; B/L 9912323 to Colombo Sri Lanka 2026-02-23), plus named foreign buyers with shipment counts. Declared HS codes 380850/380891/380892/380893 are consistent with observed records (38089135 cypermethrin, 38089399 glyphosate SG, 38089361 glyphosate technical, 38089362 paraquat, 38089999 fenobucarb) — no HS correction needed. Note the company is also a substantial importer (glyphosate/paraquat/fenobucarb technical from Shanghai, Hunan, Jiangsu suppliers), i.e. it appears to be a formulator/trader of imported technical material rather than a primary manufacturer; role should be treated as manufacturer_trader or trader, not pure manufacturer. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (672 total records) but no values, and no financials were retrievable. Domestic supply evidence: none found in reachable sources; do not treat the import activity as domestic supply evidence. Source counter vs rows seen: counter 672 shipments / 32 partners / 20 ports vs 5 shipment rows, 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows actually visible — free view is a truncated sample, so counts are indicative only.
